strings: By StarClan, m_c wishes that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could hold onto the small things, instead of feeling this heavy blanket weight of sadness and longing for things gone.
There's no reason for this, nothing has happened recently. Yet m_c wakes with a wail, the weight of grief holding {PRONOUN/m_c/object} down and aching as sharply as if someone had newly passed.
m_c stalks angrily from camp, the grief welling up in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} throat feeling like it will choke {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. m_c can't help but find it unfair that this sadness won't go away.
